text.p: Here are highlights of stories reported by Hungary's press, based on information by Nepszabadsag's Hungary Around the Clock service. For further details on how to subscribe to Hungary Around the Clock, please contact Monica Kovacs at (361) 351 7142 or fax your request to (361) 351 7141.
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn announced in Parliament on Monday he will sign a pact with the Vatican on June 20 on financing for and allocating property to the Hungarian Catholic Church
- A close vote is expected Tuesday when Parliament casts a final vote on a bill governing the appointment pf social insurance officials, as junior coalition party the Free Democrasts opposes the bill
Opposition party Fidesz's vice president Tamas Deutsch said decisions on a pre-electoral alliance among moderate centre-right parties must be made by mid-July
The defence ministry is seeking a 65 percent increase in state funding next year, primarily to upgrade its defence forces

A new act replacing the nine-year-old law on investments will liberalise the activities of foreigners by allowing them to take out of the country in any currency the proceeds and profits of their investments.
